$meta.name: GFA ATAK — Threaded Messaging & Tasking
$meta.description: Data model, template schema, API and event contracts for the cTab-free threaded messaging/tasking engine. Server-authoritative store; clients hold a disposable cache.

fieldType.bool: checkbox; may belong to an exclusiveGroup
fieldType.choice: single select from a static list
fieldType.grid: position; rendered as picker (marker dropdown / map click / manual)
fieldType.callsign: callsign string; autofillable from role system
fieldType.freq: radio frequency string; autofillable from active TFAR radio
fieldType.time: clock time; autofillable from mission time

message.description: Immutable once submitted. Bodies live only in the server store.

fields.seq: int, per-thread ordering counter — sort on this, never on time
fields.parentId: string|null, message replied to; null on root
fields.fromUid: string, taken from the caller server-side, never from client payload
fields.transition: enum threadStatus|null, state this message caused

thread.description: A task IS a thread whose root template is a tasking template. No separate task object.

fields.subject: string, derived from root template subjectFormat — never typed
fields.participants: array of uid, grows when addressees are added mid-thread
fields.boxes: array of boxId this thread is indexed under

anchor.marker: string|null — soft reference only, may be deleted
anchor.label: string snapshot of marker text

fields.messages: array of messageId in seq order

box.description: Everything is a mailbox. Individuals, groups and roles are boxes with derived membership.

members.roles: array of role variable names, e.g. isJFO

fields.forwardToAlive: bool — reportable threads in this box go to C2ISTAR

indexEntry.description: What a client receives on join. Bodies are fetched per-thread on open.

templateSchema.description: Superset of the PLANOPS Maps export format. lines[]/fields[] structure preserved; keys added for IDs, validation, autofill, pickers and state transitions.

template.id: string, stable key — do NOT use the PLANOPS uid
template.title: string
template.replyableWith: array of templateId — drives which reply buttons the thread shows
template.allowedFrom: array of enum threadStatus — states this reply is legal in
template.composeMinDevice: string — 'hud' if all fields autofill/empty, else 'eud'

line.line: string, e.g. 'Line 1' — empty fields[] means section header
line.label: string, e.g. 'LOCATION'

field.key: string, generated at conversion from position: L3.A — stable across label edits
field.label: string
field.allowManual: bool, default true — never leave a grid field dropdown-only
field.choices: array of string, choice type only

mailboxConfig.description: Named boxes are declared per mission. Personal/group/role boxes are derived and need no declaration.

validates: sender is a member of every addressed box
sender is a thread participant when threadId is set
linkState of sender is not DENIED
effects: assign id, seq, sentTime; fromUid taken from caller
create thread on root, else append
index thread into each addressed box; merge participants
push message to online recipients; forward to ALiVE if reportable and box.forwardToAlive
set claimedBy if unclaimed; post system message

GFA_fnc_notify.description: Single seam to the mission's existing notification system. Core never calls the notification API directly.

GFA_fnc_openApp.description: Cross-app navigation, e.g. ['tasks',['fromThread', threadId]]. No-ops if the app is absent.

rules: HashMaps converted to arrays before crossing the network

persistence.format: nested arrays; rebuilt with createHashMapFromArray on postInit
persistence.notes: Tied to the host machine's profile. No query layer — whole archive loads into memory. Consider iniDBI2 or ALiVE persistence if it outgrows this.

DENIED.exception: low-bandwidth templates still pass on LPI-capable radios

buildOrder: 1. Transport only — record, store, submit/receive, one hardcoded free-text template, hint output, no UI
2. Index + thread view UI, still free-text
3. Template engine — schema loader and form renderer; convert MEDEVAC first
4. Pickers and autofill — marker dropdown, map click, callsign, TFAR frequency
6. Tasking — transition metadata, reply gating, permissions, filtered Tasks view
7. Priority, notify seam, HUD widget + keybind acknowledgement
8. ALiVE ingest, map anchors, EW link-state degradation
openQuestions: Does a CustomDisplayComponent attach to an infantry unit at all? Gates any info-panel surface.
Reply defaults to the box or to the sender? Recommended: box, with explicit reply-to-sender.
Do HashMaps survive remoteExec serialization intact? Spec assumes not and converts to arrays.
Exact TFAR accessor for the active radio's frequency — activeSwRadio/activeLrRadio confirmed, settings getter unverified.
Whether ACE overrides vanilla getOxygenRemaining, if the dive instrument is built.
